name: tavily
description: Connect Tavily to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Tavily MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Tavily to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with web search for agents using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Tavily workspace.
Find anything in Tavily that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review web search for agents in Tavily.
